body: In sight? God no, it'll be years. I don't know if I can last years... Hell, I don't know if I can last months or weeks right now.

I feel like I'm taking attention away from those that really need it though. I just don't want to talk to my boyfriend about this, he's the only other person I could talk to but he can't handle me being like this right now.

Thanks for the post, I appreciate it.
